environment: Linux cloud container (Claude Code sandbox), Docker Engine 29.9.2, host networking; not a deployment host

image.build_deviation: test-only copy mounted the sandbox egress-proxy CA as a BuildKit secret (PIP_CERT) for pip install; the CA is not in the image; the committed Dockerfile is unchanged

run.options: --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:size=16m --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges:true --memory 512m --pids-limit 128, token files under /run/secrets, self-signed TLS for 127.0.0.1
run.upstream: python -m command_center --mode sim on http://127.0.0.1:8080 with an upstream operator token (loopback HTTP upstream)

results.readyz: 200 after upstream sign-in and first frame
results.tls: TLS 1.1 refused; TLS 1.2 ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384; TLS 1.3 TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384
results.auth: unauthenticated bootstrap 401; viewer role has no capabilities and its command gets 403; operator pause/resume forwarded and reported applied upstream; cross-origin command 403
results.stream: wss relay delivered protocol-v2 packets: keyframe then deltas with consecutive sequences
results.sign_in_limit: 5 wrong credentials -> 401, then 429; audit log records login_rate_limited without credential material
results.bug_found_and_fixed: service always marked the token-session cookie Secure, so the gateway's HTTP client never returned it to a plain-HTTP loopback upstream and re-signed-in every second; the cookie is now Secure exactly when served over HTTPS (test_token_session_cookie_is_secure_only_over_tls_and_works_on_plain_loopback)

not_tested: a real deployment host and DNS name
publicly trusted certificates and chain validation

compose_https_upstream.setup: docker compose with the committed deployment/gateway/compose.yaml plus a scratch override (prebuilt image, extra_hosts host.docker.internal:host-gateway); bridge network; real secret files; service on 0.0.0.0:8080 with TLS and an upstream token; gateway trusts the upstream certificate via AETHERTWIN_UPSTREAM_CA_FILE

results.roles: unauthenticated 401; viewer no capabilities, command 403; operator pause/resume applied upstream
results.stream: wss relay keyframe then consecutive deltas
results.secrets: docker inspect shows only *_FILE paths; no token value in inspect output or container logs; /run/secrets holds the three files
results.limits: mem_limit 768m and pids_limit 128 applied; read-only root; uid 10001
results.upstream_state_logging: after the fix, docker logs carry one audit line per change: unavailable (with the redacted TLS reason) and connected

checks.robot: not vulnerable (RSA key exchange not supported)
checks.secure_renegotiation: supported; client renegotiation DoS not possible

tls_scan.note: self-signed test certificate; certificate-chain and hostname results are not meaningful here

rotation_drills.gateway_certificate: files replaced; old certificate served until restart; docker compose restart -> /readyz 200 with the new certificate after 2.3 s
rotation_drills.upstream_certificate: gateway trusted an old+new CA bundle (one restart); edge restarted on the new certificate; /readyz 503 during the edge restart and 200 about 4 s later without restarting the gateway; served edge certificate matched the new one; upstream_state audit lines logged
